soft_constraints.translation: If Scarlett is a book collector, then Scarlett has a book collection.

soft_constraints.reasoning: The text directly describes her as a book collector and also mentions her collection; it is strongly implied (common-sense link) that being a book collector entails having a collection, though the entailment is not a strict definitional truth in all imaginable cases.

soft_constraints.translation: If Scarlett stumbled upon a rare book, she would decide to keep it and make it part of her literary treasures.
